news.title: When Do PINNs Beat Classical Numerical Methods? A 1D vs 5D Experiment
news.dek:
I put a physics-informed neural network up against a plain finite-difference solver twice: once in 1D and once in 5D. The winner changed. 
 The post  When Do PINNs Beat Classical Numerical Methods? A 1D vs 5D Experiment  appeared first on  Towards Data Science .
news.aiSummary: The author compared a physics-informed neural network (PINN) with a standard finite-difference solver in two experiments: one-dimensional and five-dimensional. In the 1D case, the PINN outperformed the finite-difference method, while in the 5D case the finite-difference solver was superior. The results show that the relative performance depends on dimensionality.
